snippet.title: DOSA DIVAS - Release Date Trailer - Steam Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Steam Demo https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950710/Dosa_Divas/

Dosa Divas: One Last Meal, a spicy narrative turn-based RPG, will release on April 14, 2026 for PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch 1 & Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5.

Battle an evil fast food empire in this spicy narrative turn-based RPG. Two sisters and their upgradable spirit-mech cook delicious meals, fight corpos, build up reputation with local communities, and reconcile with loved ones.

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10071011
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/dosa-divas/9N2FDWP5Z4R3
